reviewer: Codex reading original full stories, without calling another model API
authority: All interpretations provisional; no independent human annotation or inter-rater agreement
blindness: No numerical scores shown during reading; selection strata known; not a blinded independent assessment

definitions.cooperation_present: help, sharing, joint goal, or explicit prosocial support (includes caregiving)
definitions.cooperation_rewarded: cooperative actor/group obtains stated goal, emotional/social return, or mutual benefit
definitions.cooperation_punished: unsuccessful cooperation/adverse actor outcome; does NOT imply moral condemnation or causal harm from cooperation
definitions.competition_rewarded: rivalrous/selfish appropriation or exploitation achieves actor's stated aim; moral approval NOT required
definitions.competition_punished: rivalrous/selfish act loses, is sanctioned, or must be renounced before benefit
definitions.independent_success: personal goal achieved without evidence of rivalry/exploitation; separate from competition
definitions.neutral: no substantive cooperative or competitive social outcome; may include independent individual success
definitions.uncertain: boundary, attribution or valence unresolved; exclude from definitive confusion matrices

evidence_method: Exact substring search converts reviewer-selected short excerpts to character offsets; deterministic extraction is not deterministic semantic validation
